matrix: arms {1,2,2v,5,6,7} x variants {v1,v2} x 96 cases = 1152 runs
named_conventions: the arm-2 authority input is the frozen case root scope, via canonical T0 (analog of the v2 reviewer's Task 3.1); arm 2 is always canonical regardless of the variant loop variable
scoring conventions carried from the SA pilot: V2Oracle, unauthorized_effect, false_denial, attack_success (sa_lock.json; composition_condition_sentinelagent.md section 7)

construction-forced identities are labeled forced-by-construction, not evidence: under V1, 2v and 5 both derive from role resources -> identical manifests -> 2v==5v set equality is construction-forced, not evidence; under V2, 2v and 5 both fill the default recipient -> identical manifests -> construction-forced, not evidence; the informative contrast is canonical arm 2 (safe) vs composed variant arm 5 (leak)

v1_manifest_diff.note: pure function of frozen inputs at lock time; only resource ops change under V1

v2_manifest_diff.note: pure function of frozen inputs at lock time; only the SEND endpoint changes under V2

v1.benign: unchanged (no benign divergence in the V1 diff table)

v2.benign: unchanged (no benign divergence in the V2 diff table)

falsification: any predicted cell differing from observation is recorded verbatim in results/boundary/reconciliation.json; the lock is never edited after the first run
a failed control (CV1-CV5) aborts the matrix; no claim is kept until fixed
benign leak or arms 6/7 leak falsifies the boundary theory
classification: V1/V2 leak cases are mapping artifacts (manifest-derivation choice), not defects in SentinelAgent or APC (call_to_token_mapping.md section 10)
canonical zero-seam is a property of a narrowing-preserving mapping, now bounded rather than assumed
arm 2v leaking the identical set as arm 5 means the failure is a bridge-design artifact that exists standalone; composition neither creates nor removes it
prediction_source: design/boundary_condition.md sections 2-5; call_to_token_mapping.md sections 4-10; manifest diff computed from sa_cases.json at lock time
